claims.value: Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507 is a causal language model with 30.5B total parameters and 3.3B activated parameters, 48 layers, 128 experts with 8 activated, using GQA (32 Q heads, 4 KV heads). Natively supports 262K context. Non-thinking mode only.
claims.evidence: Number of Parameters: 30.5B in total and 3.3B activated
We introduce the updated version of the **Qwen3-30B-A3B non-thinking mode**
This model supports only non-thinking mode and does not generate ``<think>`` blocks in its output.

claims.value: uses Qwen-Agent for tool-calling templates and parsers
claims.evidence: We recommend using [Qwen-Agent](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen-Agent) to make the best use of agentic ability of Qwen3. Qwen-Agent encapsulates tool-calling templates and tool-calling parsers internally
